messages:
Seema: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — can leadership give a compact migration plan + ship windows for three areas: hosted API streaming/function-calling SLAs, console rollout controls (canaries/rollback UI), and Optimize automated batching/quant suggestions? short bullets please so teams can plan. :spiral_calendar:

Dmitri: short bullets: 1) API streaming SLA (p95 token latency) beta in 2 weeks, GA in ~6 weeks. 2) Console rollout controls (canary UI + RBAC) internal dogfood in 3 weeks, public beta 5 weeks. 3) Optimize suggestions (per-route opt-in) in staging this week, GA end of quarter. i'll add exact dates below.

Anya: can you clarify what "SLA" means for streaming — is it per-request or per-token? also how will function-calling factor into the SLA?

Dmitri: SLA is per-token issuance p95 measured at the model host for sequences up to 2k. function-calls counted as tokens the same way; we'll publish measurement spec and limits.

Priya: migration steps request: what do app teams need to do to opt into the SLA or the new canary controls? any api/schema changes to expect?

Dmitri: good Q. migration notes: - API streaming SLA: no request-side schema changes. Teams must opt into SLA via support contract (billing/legal). We'll provide an "SLA-enabled" flag in account settings. - Console canary controls: UI first — teams can create canaries for routes; API for canaries follows in beta. - Optimize suggestions: opt-in per-route toggle; suggestions appear as PR-like diffs you can preview before apply.

Omar: operationally, what rollback triggers will be supported? we need automated rollback on error spikes and manual quick rollback in UI.

Dmitri: initial rollback triggers: error-rate threshold, latency threshold, and explicit manual rollback. we'll support auto_rollback_on_errors and an alert webhook.

Anya: will Optimize automatically change model quantization settings? that's scary for accuracy-sensitive routes.

Dmitri: Optimize will recommend quantization profiles and expected token savings + an estimated quality delta. auto-apply will be off by default; teams must opt in per-route. recommendations include a risk score and rollback steps.

Seema: thanks — can we get concrete dates so product/planning can block work? also @deploy-bot can you set a reminder to dogfood console canaries in three weeks?

Dmitri: dates: - API streaming SLA beta: 2026-04-07, GA target: 2026-05-19. - Console canary dogfood start: 2026-04-21 (internal). public beta: 2026-05-05. - Optimize staging: 2026-03-30, GA: 2026-06-30. i'll update the roadmap doc with a short migration checklist.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: dogfood console canaries on 2026-04-21. :white_check_mark:

Priya: can you post the migration checklist here or link it? we need the minimal acceptance tests for our teams.

Dmitri: checklist (short): - confirm route ownership and RBAC for canary toggles - prepare load tests for canary_percent values (10%, 25%) - create synthetic prompts for accuracy checks - ensure alerting/webhook config for auto_rollback - for Optimize: run suggestions on staging routes and evaluate quality delta on golden prompts. i'll paste the doc link in 10m.

Seema: perfect. please ping product leads on timeline changes. closing thread but DM me if you want to join early beta.
